name: Inline Ad Entity
description: Field formatter that inserts Advertising Entity ads inline every N paragraphs of a text field.
project_description:
This module allows ad entities to be inserted within formatted text fields. Ad entities can be inserted every X number of paragraphs ( 
 

 ) using the field formatter.

 Status 
 Currently, this module is functional and accomplishes the initial goal of inserting ad entity displays every so many paragraphs tags. There are still several things that can be done to improve this module before it's first stable release, including ensuring caching is implemented properly, advertising contexts are being respected, further testing, and adding additional settings for controlling which dom element is used to determine where ads are shown.
